before: A table row whose cells all continued a vertical merge took the tallest end-of-cell paragraph of its cells, or no height when every cell hid its mark. A hidden merge-head mark took the line of the document default run properties.
after: That row takes the end-of-cell paragraph of its first cell, or one line of the default paragraph style when that cell hides its mark. A hidden merge-head mark takes the same line.
reason: The change is in table row layout only. Shared state, operations, and synchronization are unchanged.
